inputContract: batch-text-v1: {text, inherited_graph}; output nodes.source is [{quote}] with no window IDs; active prompt is the supplied v5.0.8 with its trailing version commentary removed
compatibility: old window and flat-text prompt hashes remain readable; preserve saved node/edge prefixes, vectors and paragraph progress; all new extraction uses v5.0.8 and records its actual hash per batch

batch.planning: protect heading/body, introduction/list and unfinished sentence groups first; count the actual joined body including two-newline paragraph separators, keep every new batch below 4000 Unicode characters, then favor nearby section boundaries and balance around 3500 characters; existing saved prefixes stay frozen
batch.modelWindows: one continuous text per batch, retaining paragraph separators and existing headings; local paragraph IDs and offsets are never sent; saved progress remains unchanged
batch.oversizedParagraph: stop if a complete paragraph or protected group exceeds 3999 characters; never cut through the protected structure

handoff.expansion: one hop by role and relationship
handoff.identifiers: global sequential N IDs; inherited nodes are read-only
handoff.newNodeOrder: fully located new nodes are sorted by original-text position independently of any quote failure; unlocated or partially located nodes retain model-order slots and receive an unresolved order warning, never invented source coordinates or a generation blocker
handoff.renumbering: new-node ID remap updates argument claims/support/oppose, relation endpoints, unresolved node IDs and exact ID mentions in model-written explanations; original quotes and prior graph IDs are never rewritten

bridge.trigger: remaining components after the final batch
bridge.requestsPerExplicitRun: one or more bounded packets; every detached group is preserved and there is no automatic retry
bridge.taskCoverage: all currently detached ordinal groups; no fixed group-count cap
bridge.candidateExpansion: per task, keep at most 12 candidates: main-component ordinal boundary nodes first; when the detached unit contains a claim, add at most two semantically closest claim anchors; then add one-hop structural neighbours and semantic candidates. A no-link continuation pages the remaining candidates until exhaustive
bridge.packetBudget: at most 4 tasks and at most 24000 JSON characters per request; oversized indivisible tasks are retained as unresolved without transmission or truncation; other bounded tasks continue
bridge.edgesPerTask: retain readable new model edges with warning-only semantic/role checks; identical kind/from/to proposals only log diagnostics and never append another stored arrow; old frozen graph prefixes are not rewritten
bridge.idempotency: deduplicate existingEdges before request-size checks; duplicate diagnostics are idempotent; repeated edges and unique candidate-only/self/dangling arrows are not target progress; only new unique scoped arrows touching the target, role refinements, resolved legacy proposals or genuinely advanced candidate rounds permit automatic continuation
bridge.failure: save extraction and earlier packets even when a later bridge response is unreadable; log the bridge failure; publish finished extraction with warnings and stop automatic bridge requests on warning/no progress without reporting whole-graph generation failure
bridge.completion: bridgeStatus continues to distinguish connected/explicit independent from pending or review_required, but is no longer a publication gate; all completed extraction batches may be published with unresolved warnings
bridge.initialRoleConflicts: new production parsing retains readable original edges and records role conflicts in unresolved; no forced role conversion; legacy pendingEdges remain reviewable and do not block publication

roleRevisionPolicy.storage: optional append-only roleRevisions ledger; nodes.role remains the initial extraction role; old graphs with no ledger retain their current behavior
roleRevisionPolicy.meaning: a conservative repair policy, not a claim that background is inherently unknown or less specific than all other roles
roleRevisionPolicy.semanticDecision: the bridge model separately judges node semantics and later usage from the same compact task packet, before proposing edges; edges and similarity are candidate signals only
roleRevisionPolicy.requiredEvidence: nodeEvidence quote/reason plus usageEvidence nodeId/quote/reason; witness must be a later distinct node inside the task and both quotes must exist in frozen node text
roleRevisionPolicy.localAdmission: protect append-only role history, transition/witness/evidence format and exact evidence binding; graph relation conflicts after a valid revision are warning-only, not a reason to reject the entire graph
roleRevisionPolicy.conflicts: invalid role revision proposals are logged without mutating frozen nodes; readable model edges remain with warnings even when roles disagree; mixed-node corrections require a separate workflow
roleRevisionPolicy.claimPromotion: append an empty stated_only argument when needed; upgrading a role never creates evidence or proof by itself
roleRevisionPolicy.rollback: append a revoke event for the latest active refinement; preserve history and record any resulting relation conflicts
roleRevisionPolicy.execution: role proposals are processed before new edges in compact bridge packets; original roles are not rewritten; failed role proposals do not prohibit retaining readable model edge proposals

relationPolicy: new relations carry policy=v5.0.8; local role matrix, anchored order, self/cycle, duplicates, dangling/out-of-scope endpoints, isolated nodes and disconnected components produce [本地告警] in unresolved, without deleting/retyping/redirecting the model graph or blocking generation/publication
relationCompatibility: readable support/oppose returned in relations are represented in arguments with original direction; new production edges are not quarantined for role errors. Strict validation remains available only for offline diagnostic tests. Unreadable JSON/fields, unsupported kind, unusable duplicate node identities and resource budgets remain runtime protections
localValidationPolicy: record-only for graph quality in extraction, bridge, save and read; source fingerprint, CAS revision, frozen-prefix/append-only history, checksum, vector integrity and filesystem protections remain enforced; fully processed documents publish with unresolved warnings and semanticCertified=false
anchorRepair: optional in production batch-text mode: try exact → whitespace → typography → evidenced PDF line-wrap hyphens / limited commas. If a quote remains ambiguous or cannot be located, keep the complete returned block in fallbackText, with no invented coordinates; preserve model ID order for that batch. Continue saving, handoff, bridging, embeddings and retrieval. Legacy window-mode audit remains strict
unlocatedBlocks: full returned text is retained without invented coordinates; quote-location failure and graph-quality warnings do not block generation; source-version and storage integrity protections remain
responseDiagnostics: save last raw response and exact request text locally, bound to source/prompt versions; unreadable responses remain diagnostic-only, readable graph errors are retained with warnings; no automatic resend
graphInspection: show current pending graph during extraction, then the warning-bearing published graph; include all nodes/components; missing-endpoint arrows remain stored/inspectable but cannot be drawn; RAG omits an entire dangling joint-premise edge with an explicit omission instead of crashing or inventing partial support; v5 self/duplicate/cycle warnings do not reject the entire RAG packet
tables: complete local objects; rows are not sent for argument extraction
embeddings: local paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, 384 dimensions, full node text (original replay when anchored, complete model-returned block otherwise)
storage: one active argument-graph-v5-{docId}.json; incomplete work uses .pending.json; complete publication removes legacy argument graph, old argument units/edges and archives while retaining entity facts

processingActions.body: replace the complete body chunks/vector snapshot for the same docId, never append; preserve graph files, source fingerprint gates stale graph reads
processingActions.generate: read preprocessed original paragraphs independently of body vector chunks and continue all unfinished argument batches, no reset
processingActions.regenerate: reuse preprocessed original paragraphs, reset pending graph and response diagnostics, process all batches; publish complete replacement
processingActions.all: preflight model configuration → local body reindex → reset pending graph → process all batches → publish complete replacement
processingActions.pause: stops extraction permissions, never disables existing graph retrieval
processingActions.replacement: one active version per document per index layer; v5 retrieval excludes legacy argument indices even if cleanup was interrupted; staged graph work is never included in retrieval
